name: MultiRowFormulaNode
label: Multi-Row Formula
description: Computes a new column by referencing rows before or after the current row, e.g., running totals or moving averages.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table on which the multi-row formula is applied.

fields.name: SourceColumn
fields.label: Source Column
fields.description: The name of the column used as input for the formula.

fields.name: FormulaType
fields.label: Formula Type
fields.description: The type of multi-row computation to perform.

selectOptions.label: Running Total
selectOptions.description: Cumulative sum of the column up to and including the current row.

selectOptions.label: Previous Value
selectOptions.description: Uses the value from a row that is N rows before the current row.

selectOptions.label: Next Value
selectOptions.description: Uses the value from a row that is N rows after the current row.

selectOptions.label: Difference From Previous
selectOptions.description: Computes the current value minus the value from N rows before.

selectOptions.label: Moving Average
selectOptions.description: Computes the average of the current row and N preceding rows.

fields.name: Rows
fields.label: Rows
fields.description: The number of rows to look back (or forward) for Previous/Next/Difference/Moving Average.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the output column. Defaults to the source column name.

fields.name: UpdatedDataTable
fields.label: Updated Data Table
fields.description: The data table with the multi-row formula column appended.
